remarks: Discover exceptional living in Cambrian, Sherwood Park's exciting new community where modern design meets everyday convenience. This beautifully crafted Art Homes property offers a bright and spacious floor plan, enhanced by large windows that fill the home with natural light. The heart of the home is the contemporary kitchen, featuring a large centre island, generous pantry, and seamless flow into the dining and living areas, creating the perfect space for entertaining or relaxing with family. A separate side entrance adds flexibility and future potential. The upper level is thoughtfully designed with a spacious primary retreat complete with a private ensuite, two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, a central bonus room, and an upstairs laundry room for added convenience. Surrounded by scenic walking trails, parks, playgrounds, and a nearby dog park, this home offers an outstanding lifestyle in one of Sherwood Park's most sought-after communities. (id:67522)
